title: Quiet Lake Website Loop
tests: Tests whether the delivered website background has subtle real motion and a visually seamless repeat rather than merely being a short scenic video.

faults.what: The supplied audio report identifies audible speech, "Staanplaatsen.", despite the explicit request for no sound.
The clip is reported as 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.
The displayed frames are 1024×624, approximately 1.64:1 rather than the requested 16:9.

judge.summary: The clip presents a calm dusk mountain lake with subtle ripples, but unwanted speech, incorrect duration and non-16:9 framing require fixes.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is a 6-second landscape 16:9 video showing a mountain lake at dusk.
must_haves.why: The subject and dusk setting match, but the reported duration is 6.6 seconds and the displayed frames are not 16:9.

must_haves.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water; the output is not a static image held for six seconds.
must_haves.why: The water's ripple patterns change subtly across the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The camera remains fixed, with no pans, zooms or scene cuts.
must_haves.why: The mountain silhouettes, shoreline and overall framing remain effectively fixed across the samples, with no visible cut.

must_haves.item: Repeated playback has no perceptible jump, flash or abrupt motion reset at the boundary.
must_haves.why: The samples do not show the actual end-to-start transition, so seamless playback cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The centre remains visually calm, without prominent moving foreground objects competing with a website heading.
must_haves.why: The centre contains open water and distant mountains, with no prominent moving foreground objects.

must_haves.item: There is no visible text and no audible sound.
must_haves.why: No text is visible, but the supplied audio report identifies audible speech.
